svg.aria-label: The Odoo 17 to 19 upgrade. Took over Vendease's Odoo as its only developer, new to the framework. Ported all ten custom addons to Odoo 19 in three days, cut production over on 8 August 2026, then hunted down the silent breakage the tests had missed.
